session_start.description: Initialize session: verify wpm oracle, show workspace health, confirm forbidden terms gate

pre_tool_use.message: DESTRUCTIVE GIT OPERATION DETECTED. This command may permanently destroy work. Confirm this is intentional before proceeding. Consider: git stash, git branch backup/<name>, or a dry-run alternative.
Destructive rm -rf detected. Verify path is correct and does not include source files, evidence, or receipts.
cargo publish will upload a crate to crates.io. Ensure the evidence gate has passed (wpm audit) and all invariants are green before proceeding.

post_tool_use.description: After builds and tests, evidence may be emitted to target/cargo-cicd/evidence/. Check for new .xes/.jsonl files if the evidence gate is relevant.

notes.project: cargo-cicd v26.6.2 — Rust workspace CI/CD helper with noun-verb CLI grammar
notes.forbidden_terms_note: These terms MUST NOT appear in any public output (help text, CLI, docs). The invariant test invariant_public_boundary_no_forbidden_terms_in_all_help() enforces this gate.
notes.evidence_gate: All release verdicts are adjudicated by the wasm4pm oracle (wpm binary). Tests assert wpm verdict (Accept/Refuse/Blocked), never internal cargo-cicd state.
notes.oracle_unavailable: If wpm is not on PATH, tests must declare ExpectedWpmVerdict::Blocked. Full release gate requires oracle to be available.
notes.default_verb_injection: Bare nouns auto-inject default verbs: status→show, publish→run, workspace→doctor, evidence→doctor
notes.cicd_toml: cicd.toml is a state carrier, not config. It is overwritten by each major operation. Do not rely on manual edits persisting.
